summary: The admitted v56 case first diverges at step 86 after an ordinary movement command ends in a mounted fumbling timeout. C prints “You slide to one side of the saddle.” and calls dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_FELL); JavaScript prints the same message, then records the dismount call as unported and continues without its state changes or landing draws. The queue labels the first unmatched C RNG call as steed.c:landing_spot, but the missing behavior is the caller edge in timeout.c:slip_or_trip.
